caseNameFull: Board of Education of the City of Memphis v. Northcross
attorneys: Larry B. Creson for petitioners. Marvin Brooks Norfleet for Memphis Citizens’ Council.

opinions.text: The motion of Memphis Citizens’ Council for leave to file brief, as amicus curiae, is granted. The petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit is denied.
